official_title: Providing for the condemnation and denouncement of socialism in all its forms, and for other purposes.

summary.text:
This resolution states that the House of Representatives

condemns and denounces socialism in all its forms, including the Democratic Socialists of America, and opposes the implementation of socialist policies in the United States;reaffirms its support for free, fair, and secure elections and calls for enactment of the SAVE America Act;reiterates that American elections are for American citizens only; andrecommits itself to upholding the U.S. Constitution.
